description: The plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy for the MMLU dataset. The x-axis is labeled "Initial Confidence" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.96 to 1.00, and tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three lines: a blue solid line representing "Final Accuracy" that remains relatively stable around 0.9-1.0 across the x-axis, starting at approximately 0.92 at an initial confidence of 0.96 and ending at around 0.9 at an initial confidence of 1.00; an orange solid line representing "Δ Accuracy" that decreases from around 0.4 at an initial confidence of 0.96 to approximately 0.1 at an initial confidence of 1.00, with a notable dip to around 0.2 at an initial confidence of 0.98; and a green dashed line representing "Initial Accuracy" that generally increases from around 0.5 at an initial confidence of 0.96 to approximately 0.8 at an initial confidence of 0.99, before slightly decreasing to around 0.8 at an initial confidence of 1.00.
